newsitem.title: FRANCE: Scor H1 turnover rises 13.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Scor H1 turnover rises 13.3 pct.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)

NOTE - Reinsurance company Scor published its sales figures in the Official Bulletin (Balo). It said on constant exchange rates, the advance in turnover, mainly due to non-life business, was five percent. The company said that recent floods in central Europe would have no impact on the group's results and were expected to represent net costs of 80 million francs. The company said in a statement that it had no exposure to the crash of a Boeing 747 jumbo jet flown by Korean Air Lines at Guam on August 6, nor the crash of a McDonnell Douglas DC8 operated by Fine Air at Miami, August 7. -- Paris Newsroom +33 1 4221 5452
